name: Downsky Causeway
description: An original first-person 3D causeway of offset floating terraces leads to an illuminated pavilion. The route is physical and descending-only: after stepping down, a higher terrace cannot be recovered.

metadata.variant_count_kind: five palettes × two mirrored presentations × four deterministic layout rolls
metadata.notes: Visible platform top faces, side faces, heights, gaps, and collision geometry are generated from the same world contract. The public page omits the route solution; the independent grader replays ordinary movement/look events against the platform geometry and rejects wrong interaction sources.
